knowledge:
- key_parameters: selectN=Controls the number of spots to compute entropy for. Specifying a subset (e.g., 1/10th of total spots) speeds up computation on large datasets ;; min_radius=Controls the minimum distance between two closest identified ROI centers to prevent or minimize overlaps ;; radius=Radius size used to calculate entropy around a spot ;; weight=A data frame assigning weights to each cell type for entropy calculation ;; whichDB=Database for GSEA in DoGSEA ("hallmark", "kegg", "reactome", or custom via gmtdir) ;; withProp=Logical indicating whether proportion information is used in GSEA
- alternatives: CARD, RCTD (spacexr), or cell2location can be used to obtain cell type proportions before running RegionalST. BayesSpace is used for spatial preprocessing and plotting
- when_to_use: When analyzing spatial transcriptomics data (like 10x Visium) where spots contain mixtures of cells, and you want to identify high-entropy regions of interest (ROIs) and perform cell-type-specific differential expression across these regions
- pitfalls: Calculating entropy for all spots (selectN = length(sce$spot)) can be very slow on large datasets; users should subset selectN (e.g., 1/5 or 1/10 of spots). Visium data is not single-cell resolution, so using raw cell type labels instead of deconvolution proportions only indicates the major cell type per spot, which may reduce accuracy. Ensure the SingleCellExperiment object has required BayesSpace spatial coordinate metadata (array_col, array_row, pxl_col_in_fullres, pxl_row_in_fullres) before plotting

workflows.name: analysis_with_cell_type_proportions
workflows.intent: Perform ROI selection, cross-regional differential expression, and pathway enrichment using continuous cell type deconvolution proportions.
input: CARD_obj (deconvolution results containing cell type proportions)
workflows.stages: 1. Load and preprocess spatial data using BayesSpace ;; 2. Define cell type weights and calculate weighted entropy at a given radius ;; 3. Automatically or manually select Regions of Interest (ROIs) based on entropy ;; 4. Perform cross-regional cell type-specific differential expression ;; 5. Run GSEA pathway enrichment on the DE genes and visualize
workflows.code:
example_sce <- example_sce[, colSums(counts(example_sce)) > 0]
example_sce <- mySpatialPreprocess(example_sce, platform="Visium")
example_sce$"array_col" <- example_sce$col
example_sce$"array_row" <- example_sce$row
example_sce$"pxl_col_in_fullres" <- example_sce$imagecol
example_sce$"pxl_row_in_fullres" <- example_sce$imagerow
weight <- data.frame(celltype = c("Cancer Epithelial", "CAFs", "T-cells", "Endothelial",
                                  "PVL", "Myeloid", "B-cells", "Normal Epithelial", "Plasmablasts"),
                     weight = c(0.25,0.05,
                                0.25,0.05,
                                0.025,0.05,
                                0.25,0.05,0.025))
OneRad <- GetOneRadiusEntropy_withProp(example_sce,
                             selectN = length(example_sce$spot),
                             weight = weight,
                             radius = 5,
                             doPlot = TRUE,
                             mytitle = "Radius 5 weighted entropy")
example_sce <- RankCenterByEntropy_withProp(example_sce, 
                                    weight,
                                    selectN = round(length(example_sce$spot)/5),
                                    topN = 3, 
                                    min_radius = 10,
                                    radius_vec = c(5,10),
                                    doPlot = TRUE)
PlotOneSelectedCenter(example_sce,ploti = 1)
DrawRegionProportion_withProp(example_sce,
                              label = "CellType",
                              selCenter = c(1,2,3))
CR12_DE <- GetCrossRegionalDE_withProp(example_sce, 
                                       twoCenter = c(1,2),
                                       label = "celltype",
                                       angle = 30,
                                       hjust = 0,
                                       size = 3,
                                       padj_filter = 0.05,
                                       doHeatmap = TRUE)
thisID1 <- S4Vectors::metadata(example_sce)$selectCenters$selectID[1]
thisRadius1 <- S4Vectors::metadata(example_sce)$selectCenters$selectRadius[1]
OutRegRes1 <- RegionalST::FindRegionalCells(example_sce,
                                            centerID = thisID1,
                                            radius = 20,
                                            enhanced = FALSE,
                                            doPlot = FALSE,
                                            returnPlot = FALSE)
thisID2 <- S4Vectors::metadata(example_sce)$selectCenters$selectID[2]
thisRadius2 <- S4Vectors::metadata(example_sce)$selectCenters$selectRadius[2]
OutRegRes2 <- RegionalST::FindRegionalCells(example_sce,
                                            centerID = thisID2,
                                            radius = 20,
                                            enhanced = FALSE,
                                            doPlot = FALSE,
                                            returnPlot = FALSE)
Regional1ID <- OutRegRes1$closeID
Regional2ID <- OutRegRes2$closeID
CTS_DE <- GetCellTypeSpecificDE_withProp(example_sce,
                                           Regional1ID = Regional1ID,
                                           Regional2ID = Regional2ID,
                                           n_markers = 10,
                                           angle = 30,
                                           hjust = 0,
                                           size = 3,
                                           padj_filter = 1,
                                           doHeatmap = FALSE)
lCTres <- list(CTS_DE)
CTres <- DoGSEA(lCTres, whichDB = "hallmark", withProp = TRUE)
DrawDotplot(CTres, CT = 1, angle = 15, vjust = 1, chooseP = "padj")

workflows.name: analysis_with_cell_type_labels
workflows.intent: Perform ROI selection, cross-regional differential expression, and pathway enrichment using discrete cell type labels (e.g., major cell type per spot).
input: cell_type_labels (discrete cell type annotations per spot)
workflows.stages: 1. Load and preprocess spatial data ;; 2. Define cell type weights and calculate weighted entropy using discrete labels ;; 3. Automatically select ROIs based on label entropy ;; 4. Perform cross-regional differential expression using raw labels ;; 5. Run GSEA pathway enrichment on the DE results
workflows.code:
weight <- data.frame(celltype = c("Cancer Epithelial", "CAFs", "T-cells", "Endothelial",
                                  "PVL", "Myeloid", "B-cells", "Normal Epithelial", "Plasmablasts"),
                     weight = c(0.25,0.05,
                                0.25,0.05,
                                0.025,0.05,
                                0.25,0.05,0.025))
OneRad <- GetOneRadiusEntropy(example_sce,
                              selectN = length(example_sce$spot),
                              weight = weight,
                              label = "celltype",
                              radius = 5,
                              doPlot = TRUE,
                              mytitle = "Radius 5 weighted entropy")
example_sce <- RankCenterByEntropy(example_sce, 
                           weight,
                           selectN = round(length(example_sce$spot)/2),
                           label = "celltype",
                           topN = 3, 
                           min_radius = 10,
                           radius_vec = c(5,10),
                           doPlot = TRUE)
CR12_DE <- GetCrossRegionalDE_raw(example_sce,
                                  twoCenter = c(1,2),
                                  label = "celltype",
                                  logfc.threshold = 0.1,
                                  min.pct = 0.1,
                                  angle = 30,
                                  hjust = 0,
                                  size = 3,
                                  padj_filter = 0.05,
                                  doHeatmap = FALSE)

DrawDotplot(allCTres, CT = 3, angle = 15, vjust = 1, chooseP = "padj")
